findings.title: API Gateway v2 stage without access logging
findings.description: A v2 (HTTP/WebSocket) stage without an access_log_settings block leaves no audit trail of API invocations, hampering incident response and anomaly detection.
findings.remediation: Enable audit logging. Turn on CloudTrail (multi-region, log file validation, KMS-encrypted bucket), VPC flow logs, and service access logs. Ship logs to a dedicated, MFA-delete-protected bucket in a security account.
